item.title: The Incarnation and the Christian Worldview
item.description: The Incarnation is not merely a Christmas doctrine but the foundation of the Christian worldview. In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins explains how the Word becoming flesh shapes our understanding of humanity, creation, truth, ethics, salvation, and hope in a confused age.
